Dominion Energy Ohio was recognized for its Home Performance with Energy Star program, a residential home energy assessment program. The award recognizes companies that have made outstanding contributions in the transition to a clean energy future. “Our company is committed to achieving net zero by 2050 and energy efficiency will be key in helping us deliver on our promise.
